title: Tech 3
note: Extended layer above leaf_tech_a2. Devices, accounts and what goes wrong with them. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: only 15 of the 36 tiles were new against the pool at this slot. F7: seventeen same-sense repeats (device, screen, keyboard, charger, camera, printer, tablet, download, upload, delete, password, account, link, virus, error, warning, fix) moved to two **You already know** boards; the list was refilled with hardware, browser, subscription, notification, settings, stream, cable, plug, socket, screenshot, scan, wireless, touchscreen, folder, spam, scam and signal. A12: four tiles are the computer sense of a word the student already has — **mouse (computer)** against the animal, **speaker (for sound)** against the person, **save (a file)** against *ušetřit*, **block (a user)** against the city block — and an intro table puts the four pairs side by side. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 items. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_technology_b1 — 0 unknown types.

intro.title: You already know · what you do with them
intro.title_cz: Už znáš · co s nimi děláš

intro.title: Accounts, and when it goes wrong
intro.title_cz: Účty a když se to pokazí

intro.title: Four words you already know in a new sense
You will use these words in
frames: The … is slow because … · *… je pomalý, protože …*
The … does not work when … · *… nefunguje, když …*
intro.note: **hack** is what a person does to a system; a **bug** is a mistake in the program itself. Neither is a **virus** — that is a program somebody wrote to do damage.
intro.note_cz: hack = útok člověka · bug = chyba v programu · virus = škodlivý program.
